notes.title: Easter update 2019
notes.notes:
Hey there, fellow artist!

We've added in a secret easter level for you to find. In this level you can decorate the eggs and the easter bunny.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33431260/eda82823bd75a2745f4dbeb7cb6f851dbe94e9cb.png

You can post your cool drawings in the community section!

We find your feedback to be very valuable to us and yourselves, so let us know of any problems you encounter or ideas and suggestions you have.
You can contact us at kristen@futuruum.ee.

notes.title: ABC Paint Multiplayer Update!
notes.notes:
Huge multiplayer update time!

What is more fun than simple painting in VR? Simple painting in VR with friends, of course! 

With the latest and greatest update we have done the following:

 Re-written backend (now running on Unity)
 Multiplayer support with VOIP (up to 4 people in a single room)
 Different environments (empty scene, christmas theme, car, stage, people)
 Randomized heads for the players 


Still in the works:

 Attaching paint strokes to player head
 More environments to come
 MixCast support


With this huge update we still tried to keep everything as simple and "kid-friendly" as possible: the new menu features only a few large colour coded buttons that are always at the player height and should make it easy to start solo and multiplayer sessions by simply touching the spheres. The server list only shows games created by Steam friends.

Don't like the update? No problem! The original version of the game is available under the "singleplayer" beta branch from Steam (right click on the game > properties >  betas).

Please send all your thoughts, feedback and potential problems to Madis@futuruum.ee - as we are developing this app solely for VR arcade use, we would love to get feedback and act fast on it.
